title: Guidelines for use of the RTI Online Portal
issuer: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
excerpt: The portal supports Central authorities, a 3,000-character request field and PDF support, online payment, BPL certificate upload and online first appeals without a fee.
notes: Live operational guidance; checksum capture and periodic change monitoring remain pending.

legalRti.notes: Portal behavior must be reviewed alongside the Act and Rules.
